title: Refund of a Booking Deposit on a Late-Cancelled In-Person Appointments Visit: Amount
content:
**Refund amount on a late-cancelled In-Person Appointments visit.**

(1) *Deposit held.* The deposit held on the visit is the total of the deposits collected on it less the total already released from it, both read from the visit's fee and deposit history.

(2) *Fee the refund offsets.* The late-cancellation fee the refund offsets is the visit type's late-cancellation fee when the visit's cancellation is recorded with timing late, and nothing otherwise. That fee is reckoned in one order: its starting amount is raised first, sums added to it are then added to that figure, and it is rounded to the cent only at the end. For a cancellation recorded late the starting amount is the visit type's late-cancellation fee from the fee schedule.

(3) *Refund.* The refund amount is the deposit held on the visit, less the late-cancellation fee the refund offsets, plus the amount recorded on the visit as waived for its late-cancellation fee, rounded to the cent. The amount recorded as waived is the total of the waiver entries for the late-cancellation fee in the visit's fee and deposit history; where there is none, it is nothing.

### Worked example (hypothetical visit)

A Specialist Consultation, late-cancellation fee $40.00 in the fee schedule, cancelled with timing late.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Deposits collected on the visit | $150.00 |
| Already released from it | $0.00 |
| Deposit held | $150.00 |
| Late-cancellation fee the refund offsets | $40.00 |
| Amount recorded as waived for the late-cancellation fee | $0.00 |
| Refund: 150.00 less 40.00, plus 0.00 | **$110.00** |

The same visit with a waiver entry of $40.00 for its late-cancellation fee: 150.00 less 40.00, plus 40.00, gives **$150.00**.

### Points of judgement

- The deposit held is worked out from the history entries, collections less releases, not taken from any single entry.
- Only waiver entries for the late-cancellation fee of this visit enter the refund; entries for any other fee do not.
